new.n: Murdered Olson brothers' money 'hidden about the place', near Bristol Center
new.pl: W½ NW¼ sec 20 T101N R11W, Bristol Twp, at the house mark on the 1928 Fillmore County atlas; about 1.7 km WSW of Bristol Center
new.st: Dec 1936: two aged bachelor brothers were killed on their farm by robbers after money they were known to keep at home. One still had $850 in his pockets; the other's money belt was never found. Neighbours believed large sums were hidden about the place; nothing was reported found, and the case was unsolved in 1941.
new.t: Farmstead yard, outbuildings and the grain-stack ground near the house. Private land: ask permission.
